params.body:
## What

Future features land on `main` in small pull requests behind a flag; the approval is the flag itself. This PR builds that layer and moves the three existing flags onto it.

**Storage.** `feature_flags` (key, stage `off|admins|dealers|everyone`, `dealer_ids`, note) and `feature_flag_changes` (flag, from, to, dealer list, user, time; append-only). Migration `2026_09_16_120000_create_feature_flags_tables` also adds the menu row `features` under the settings menu (the Beheer dropdown) with a view right for role 1, and seeds a row only for a flag the environment has switched away from its default (see below).

**API.** `App\Support\Features`:
- `enabled($key, ?User)` is the one question the app asks. Internally `released() && entitled()`.
- `released()` is the rollout: `everyone` true for all (also no user); `dealers` for the listed dealer ids and administrators; `admins` for administrators; `off` false. Unknown key: false plus one log warning per process.
- `entitled()` is the package right: always true today, docblock says where packages (Basis / Plus / Premium) plug in later; `FeaturesTest` pins the current answer.
- `catalogue()` lists the known flags with `package_bound` (false for all three); titles and descriptions in `resources/lang/{nl,fr,en,de}/features.php`.
- The table is read once per request and cached 60 s; every write (model event and `Features::set`) empties the cache.
- `relationProposals()` keeps its signature and delegates. `OwnStockController` and `Delegation::optInEnforced()` call `Features::enabled('livewire_vehicle_form' | 'delegation_opt_in', Auth::user())`.

**Environment fallback.** Without a row, `config/features.php` decides: true = `everyone`, false = `off`, a `_dealers` list = `dealers`; `relation_proposals` stands on `admins` without a row (the code already had "on for admins, off for dealers" since 15 September). With a row the database wins. Documented in `config/features.php` and `docs/feature-flags.md`.

**Screen.** Beheer > Functies (`/features`, `App\Livewire\Admin\FeatureFlags`): per flag the title, description, the stage as four radio options with a line of help each, the dealer picker (checklist by name with a search field, only at `dealers`), a note, Opslaan, and the last three changes ("Demo StockCars zette op beheerders, 16/09/2026 10:19"). "pakketgebonden" as a muted label when `package_bound`; "uit de omgeving, nog niet op dit scherm gezet" while no row exists. Confirms with `ui.notify` through the existing `flash` event. Non-administrators: 403 on the component, the Access middleware sends them home on the route.

**Docs and rules.** `docs/feature-flags.md` (stages, flow, adding a flag, fallback, redesigns as a separate route/component, flag = rollout vs package = right). Rules R P2-12.1 to P2-12.5 in `32-p2-mijn-garage.md`; R P2-11.1 now points at the flag screen.

## Decisions

- **No Pennant.** Four stages plus a dealer list and a change log with the acting user is more surface than Pennant gives for free; plain Eloquent plus a small `Features` API keeps the surface ours.
- **Seed only what the environment changed.** Twelve test files (including `SmokeTest`) still toggle these flags with `config([...])`. A seeded `off` row in the test database would make the database win and break them, and it would change nothing in production (the fallback gives the same answer). So the migration writes a row only where `LIVEWIRE_VEHICLE_FORM`, `LIVEWIRE_VEHICLE_FORM_DEALERS`, `RELATION_PROPOSALS` or `DELEGATION_OPT_IN` is set away from its default; those rows get a change record without user ("Overgenomen uit de omgeving"). Production behaves after the deploy exactly as before.
- **Menu row.** Same mechanism as `add_insights_module`: a `menus` row (security `features`, route `features.index`) under the top-level settings menu so it shows in the Beheer dropdown, with a `role_access` row for role 1. Labels in `resources/lang/*/menu.php` (translations are file-based now).
- **`delegation_opt_in` is asked for the user at the keyboard** (the admin starting a delegation, the dealer on the company sheet). At stage `admins` the consent check is therefore enforced for administrators while the dealer's switch stays hidden; `everyone` is the state the old `true` meant.

## Tests

New: `tests/Unit/FeaturesTest.php` (12), `tests/Feature/FeatureFlagsScreenTest.php` (5), `tests/Feature/FeatureCatalogueTest.php` (3). Green locally alongside LanguageParity, StylesheetSyntax, AlpineExpression, CompiledViews, RouteCache, Smoke, RulesCoverage, RulesIdentity, AccessWithoutSessionRights, HandlerWiring, Delegation, VehicleProposal, ProposalPublicPage, VehicleSheetHeader, VinLookupMessage, DamageTab, PhotoGalleriesSeparate, PhotoSelectAll, VehicleSheetVatChoice, ButtonLabelCapitalization, FrenchTranslations, ClassReferencesResolve (157 tests).

Screenshots at 1440 and 390 were taken on a local demo database (Beheer > Functies, one flag switched to beheerders, the dealer picker open).
params.title: Feature flags with four stages, switchable by administrators
